Local government units in Metro Manila and adjacent areas should have uniform truck ban hours, among other coordinated policies, to ease traffic jams especially during the Christmas season, the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) said on Monday. 

Victor Nuñez, director of the MMDA Traffic Enforcement Group, made the response after a traffic jam on Marcos Highway over the weekend left motorists stranded on the road for as much as six hours.

data.raw_text:
PAGHAHANDA SA HOLIDAY CARMAGEDDON 

Nagpatawag na ng meeting ang Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) kasama ang ilang local government units (LGUs) para tugunan ang tumitinding traffic sa Metro Manila ngayong holiday season.  

Kabilang sa mga inimbitahan ang ilang opisyal mula Marikina, Cainta, Antipolo, at Quezon City na nakakasakop sa Marcos Highway.  

Matatandaang tumukod ang traffic sa ilang kalsada na papasok at palabas ng Marikina, Pasig, at Antipolo nitong weekend.  

Sa panayam sa "One Balita Pilipinas" sa One PH, sinabi ni MMDA Traffic Enforcement Group Director Atty. Victor Nuñez na dulot ito ng nagsabay-sabay na minor accidents sa lugar.
